Findings on changing `projectAccess` (`backend/src/middleware/project-access.ts:16`). The call sites come from grep. I mapped test files to routes by filename and did not open them.

**Callers: 18 route call sites in 4 router files**
- `backend/src/routes/projects.routes.ts:29,34,40,43,48,54`: 6 sites. Lines 34, 40, 48 and 54 use `roles: ['OWNER'], write: true`. Lines 29 and 43 are read-only.
- `backend/src/routes/tasks.routes.ts:32,39,46,53,60,67,74`: 7 sites. Lines 32, 53, 60, 67 and 74 use `write: true`. Lines 39 and 46 are read-only.
- `backend/src/routes/comments.routes.ts:30,37,44,51`: 4 sites. Lines 30, 44 and 51 use `write: true`. Line 37 is read-only.
- `backend/src/routes/activity.routes.ts:23`: 1 site, read-only.

**Behaviours a change could alter** (`project-access.ts`)
- Check order is 404 at lines 31-34, then 403 at lines 35-38, then 409 at lines 39-42. This order is also specified in `openspec/specs/projects/spec.md:112`.
- It sets `res.locals.project` and `res.locals.membership` at lines 43-44. Nothing in `backend/src` reads them, so changing their shape has no code impact today.
- It reads `res.locals.userId` at line 21, which `authenticate` sets (`backend/src/middleware/authenticate.ts:8`).
- `backend/src/services/projects.service.ts:69,87` rely on it having already checked membership and rejected writes to an archived project (409). Changes to the 404 or 409 behaviour affect those services.
